jobs.title: Senior Electrical Engineer
jobs.description: Senior Electrical Engineer Location: San Francisco, CA (full time, in-person) Company Overview Our mission is to build a city on Mars and accelerate the construction of critical infrastructure on Earth. Starting with Cosmic-1 – a system that installs solar panels 10x faster than today’s methods, helping us transition to a clean energy future and laying the groundwork for the future of autonomous construction. The Role As a Senior Electrical Engineer, you will own a critical Cosmic-1 subsystem and lead development from concept to deployment. As a core member of the team, you will help define the era of autonomous construction. This is a rare opportunity to: - Work on hard, meaningful problems that impact the future of infrastructure and energy. - Collaborate with a world-class team from NASA, SpaceX, Google, Built Robotics, and others. - Rapidly grow, learn, and lead within a quickly scaling company. Responsibilities - Own hardware components and systems such as the high voltage system, low voltage system, custom HV batteries, embedded systems, PCB assemblies, and harnesses - Full product lifecycle ownership from requirements collection, trade studies, preliminary and detailed design, development, and overseeing manufacturing, integration, testing, and customer delivery - Work with manufacturing, mechanical, software, and product engineers to develop innovative new solutions to complex interdisciplinary problems - Work with vendors and suppliers to find creative solutions to tight deadlines - Set milestones, plan roadmaps, and deliver on ambitious timelines - Recruit, mentor, and build a world-class engineering organization Requirements - 3+ years of professional engineering experience - Excellent first-principles understanding of analog and digital circuit design and circuit analysis and simulation - Expert electrical design skills using software such as Altium designer - Strong programming skills in Python or C++ - Superb failure analysis and electrical system troubleshooting skills - Experience designing or developing high voltage vehicle electrical systems including familiarity with high voltage batteries and power electronics as well as HV safety standards and components - Excellent communication and project management skills - Thrive in fast-paced environments and push boundaries to meet deadlines Bonus - 5+ years of professional engineering experience in electrical design or development - Management and recruiting experience

raw.title: Senior Electrical Engineer
raw.descriptionHtml:
Senior Electrical Engineer

Location: San Francisco, CA (full time, in-person)

Company Overview

Our mission is to build a city on Mars and accelerate the construction of critical infrastructure on Earth. Starting with Cosmic-1 – a system that installs solar panels 10x faster than today’s methods, helping us transition to a clean energy future and laying the groundwork for the future of autonomous construction.

The Role

As a Senior Electrical Engineer, you will own a critical Cosmic-1 subsystem and lead development from concept to deployment. As a core member of the team, you will help define the era of autonomous construction.

This is a rare opportunity to:

  • Work on hard, meaningful problems that impact the future of infrastructure and energy.

  • Collaborate with a world-class team from NASA, SpaceX, Google, Built Robotics, and others.

  • Rapidly grow, learn, and lead within a quickly scaling company.

Responsibilities

  • Own hardware components and systems such as the high voltage system, low voltage system, custom HV batteries, embedded systems, PCB assemblies, and harnesses

  • Full product lifecycle ownership from requirements collection, trade studies, preliminary and detailed design, development, and overseeing manufacturing, integration, testing, and customer delivery

  • Work with manufacturing, mechanical, software, and product engineers to develop innovative new solutions to complex interdisciplinary problems

  • Work with vendors and suppliers to find creative solutions to tight deadlines

  • Set milestones, plan roadmaps, and deliver on ambitious timelines

  • Recruit, mentor, and build a world-class engineering organization

Requirements

  • 3+ years of professional engineering experience

  • Excellent first-principles understanding of analog and digital circuit design and circuit analysis and simulation

  • Expert electrical design skills using software such as Altium designer

  • Strong programming skills in Python or C++

  • Superb failure analysis and electrical system troubleshooting skills

  • Experience designing or developing high voltage vehicle electrical systems including familiarity with high voltage batteries and power electronics as well as HV safety standards and components

  • Excellent communication and project management skills

  • Thrive in fast-paced environments and push boundaries to meet deadlines

Bonus

  • 5+ years of professional engineering experience in electrical design or development

  • Management and recruiting experience

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Software Engineer
jobs.description: Forward Deployed Software Engineer Location: San Francisco, CA (full time, in-person) Company Overview Our mission is to build a city on Mars and accelerate the construction of critical infrastructure on Earth. Starting with Cosmic-1 – a system that installs solar panels 10x faster than today’s methods, helping us transition to a clean energy future and laying the groundwork for the future of autonomous construction. The Role As a Forward Deployed Software Engineer, you will be the bridge between our cutting-edge robotics and our customers, owning the end-to-end deployment and long-term success of robots in the field. You will work hand-in-hand with our customers to develop, deploy, and ensure the optimal performance of the best construction robots in the world. This role is crucial for extending our platform with new features based on direct customer feedback and driving its adoption. As a core member of the team, you will help define the era of autonomous construction. This is a rare opportunity to: - Work on hard, meaningful problems that impact the future of infrastructure and energy. - Collaborate with a world-class team from NASA, SpaceX, Google, Built Robotics, and others. - Rapidly grow, learn, and lead within a quickly scaling company. Responsibilities - Own the full robot deployment lifecycle at customer sites, from initial setup and commissioning to field validation and long-term maintenance. - Work directly with customers as a technical partner, translating their operational needs into requirements for new robot and platform features. - Develop, integrate, and deploy new features to meet specific customer requirements. - Triage and debug issues in the field and ensure high robot uptime. - Set milestones, plan roadmaps, and deliver on ambitious timelines for customer deployments and feature delivery. Requirements - 2+ years of professional engineering experience. - Excellent first-principles understanding of system-level engineering, including robotics, software, and hardware interaction. - Strong experience in robotics, system integration, and software development (e.g., Python, C++). - Demonstrated experience owning the full product lifecycle from customer requirements collection to field deployment. - Familiarity with deployment and diagnostic tools for robotic systems. - Excellent communication and project management skills. - Thrive in fast-paced environments and push boundaries to meet deadlines. Bonus - 5+ years of professional engineering experience in a technical field role. - Experience with forward deployment, field engineering, or technical consulting in a robotics field. - Management and recruiting experience.
